stories.title: Generate RSS/Atom feed at /feed.xml for blog content distribution
stories.description: Create an RSS/Atom XML feed at /feed.xml that automatically publishes blog posts with metadata (title, description, author, date, link). Enable external readers and aggregators to subscribe to new blog content.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /feed.xml returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with Content-Type: application/rss+xml header
Each <item> includes <title>, <link>, <pubDate>, <description>, and <guid> from published blog posts in reverse chronological order
Feed includes <lastBuildDate> that updates when blog posts change, and <channel> metadata with hostel name and description
technicalNotes: File to create: app/feed.xml/route.ts — RSS route handler using rss package (~80 lines)
File to update: lib/blog.ts — ensure getBlogPosts() returns pubDate, slug, excerpt, and author
Test command: curl http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | xmllint --noout - (validate XML structure)
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 0 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Add JB News & Updates widget to homepage with curated RSS feed integration
stories.description: Create a homepage widget that fetches and displays 3-4 latest items from curated JB tourism, news, and event RSS feeds (e.g., Johor State Tourism, TimeOut KL JB events). Cache results for 6 hours to avoid hitting external feeds too frequently.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeNewsWidget component displays 3-4 recent news items with title, date, source name, and clickable link
RSS feed URLs are configurable in environment variables and validated on page load; invalid URLs are skipped silently
Component falls back gracefully if any feed fetch fails — shows cached data from previous fetch or empty 'No news available' state

stories.title: Create dynamic blog tag pages at /blog/tags/[tag] for long-tail keyword SEO
stories.description: Generate dynamic tag pages at /blog/tags/[tag] that list all blog posts with a specific tag. Extract tags from blog post frontmatter and auto-generate pages with proper breadcrumbs, metadata, and internal linking. Add tag cloud to blog list for navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Tag page at /blog/tags/backpacker displays all posts tagged 'backpacker' with meta description, title, and BreadcrumbList schema
Each blog post frontmatter includes tags array (e.g., tags: ['backpacker', 'budget', 'singapore']); getTags() returns unique list
Blog post cards show clickable tags that link to /blog/tags/[tag]; tag pages show 'Back to Blog' and related tags links
technicalNotes: File to create: app/blog/tags/[tag]/page.tsx — dynamic route with generateStaticParams (~70 lines)
File to update: lib/blog.ts — add getTags() and getPostsByTag(tag: string) functions (~50 lines total)
File to update: components/BlogPostCard.tsx — display and link tags
Test command: npm test lib/blog.test.ts -t 'getPostsByTag' -v (verify post filtering by tag)

stories.title: Generate dynamic Open Graph images for blog posts using Next.js ImageResponse
stories.description: Create dynamic Open Graph images for blog posts using Next.js @vercel/og that display post title, author, publication date, and hostel branding. Improves social media preview appearance and click-through rates on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /blog/[slug]/opengraph-image returns a 1200×630px PNG image with post title, author name, publication date, and hostel logo overlaid
og:image meta tag in blog post page head correctly references /blog/[slug]/opengraph-image; og:image:width=1200 and og:image:height=630
Image generation completes in <1s and can be cached for 1 week (Cache-Control: max-age=604800)
technicalNotes: File to create: app/blog/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx — ImageResponse component (~80 lines)
File to update: app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx — add generateMetadata() with og:image metadata object
Test command: npm run build && curl http://localhost:3000/blog/sample-post/opengraph-image -I (verify Content-Type: image/png)
